text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I got closer... Much 
closer to my "friend"... than before...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"A speed... I've never reached before... 
The scenery... went by in an instant..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I could produce this kind of 
speed on the final straight was surely..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I can still... do so 
much more than this...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I can aim as far as I want... Even if I 
have to throw everything away, I'll go 
even further...!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka-san... It's because she was 
there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I need to have that kind of spirit, too... 
Next time, even more...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh... Did you see that, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It reached...! Almost reached it... Just 
the tip of my toe, but... finally!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shouting aloud, Agnes Tachyon leaped over 
the fence and sprinted toward Manhattan 
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, tell me...! What did you see? What 
did you see far off in the distance!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The moment you hit top speed, your 
expression shifted ever so slightly. Just 
what in the world was that...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... for a split second...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: In the distance... an unfamiliar light...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Light...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The world we live in right now... Yet, 
that distant light is..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It felt like something that didn't belong 
in this world. A light known only... to my 
"friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I touch that... it feels like 
everything might change. What once was an 
illusion would no longer be one...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"The meaning of being born an Umamusume... 
I feel like I'm finally starting to 
understand it..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The meaning... of being born an 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No way... The Zone is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see! I see, I see! Finally!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the fruit of our labor! Thanks to 
my plan, you are finally about to reach 
that realm...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good, good, this is fine. This is totally 
fine! It could have been anyone, you or 
anybody else!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It has to work! You, it's you! Yes... 
You!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However... I see... It's you, isn't it? 
You... only you can go beyond...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah...? A-Aaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, an uncharacteristic scream 
from Agnes Tachyon —scorched the sky.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Damn it, damn it, damn it all...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Be satisfied... Be satisfied...!! Fill up! 
Fill up alreadyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you satisfied?! Moving forward from 
here, my goal, my goal is...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even so—will I still not be able to see 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It could have been Cafe, or anyone else! 
Even me! But――"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm "NOT THE ONLY ONE"?! ...O-Ooooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A mere impulse. A thirst for something. 
But this voice... I feel like I've heard 
it somewhere before."
( R O O O O A A R ! )

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt it, as if my "friend" had uttered 
it... A voiceless voice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Is it really... decided, then...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is the outcome set in stone... unable to 
be overturned...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, no, no no no...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With this new "key"...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san, um...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me. I just remembered... I have 
something to take care of.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This wasn't in the plan... It wasn't 
supposed to be like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving those words behind as she walked 
away, Agnes Tachyon staggered more 
unsteadily than I had ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about running with Silence 
Suzuka-san today...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it had meaning. Just like when 
I ran with Special Week...
choice_data_list: Is this race also... part of my guidance?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. We called off the overseas trip, 
but even so, my "friend" was in front of 
her today...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka-san... Running with her, 
there's something...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was there some kind of invisible causality 
at play? If so, then that must be...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there's something TM 
Opera O-san said before.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Casual words... Yet, somehow, they left 
quite an impression..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O-san said this about me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Leckermaul's Companion", right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A companion means someone who stays by 
your side, right? Then what does 
'Leckermaul' mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words that seem connected to causality. 
Though it could just be completely made 
up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Putting aside speculation for now, let us 
return to the 'friend.' If they haven't 
vanished, I do feel that I want to let 
them pursue it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to go on the overseas 
campaign, but somehow, I want to keep the 
dream alive...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—An overseas expedition. Thinking about 
that sparked an idea.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, and so, the next goal is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it was a substitute for an 
overseas expedition. However, there was no 
need to explain that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Trainer. That place... is our 
France, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Japan Cup.
